[[Hokkaido Consadole Sapporo|Consadole Sapporo]] | league topscorer = [[Naohiro Takahara]] (26 goals) | matches = 240 | total goals = 683 | highest attendance = 57,902 [[Urawa Red Diamonds|Reds]] vs. [[Júbilo Iwata|Júbilo]] (July 13) | lowest attendance = 3,287 [[JEF United Chiba|JEF Utd.]] vs [[Vegalta Sendai|Vegalta]] (September 18） | average attendance = 16,368 | prevseason = [[2001 J.League Division 1|2001]] | nextseason = [[2003 J.League Division 1|2003]] | higherleague = }} The '''2002 J.League Division 1 season''' was the tenth season since the establishment of the '''[[J1 League|J.League Division 1]]'''. The league began on March 2 and ended on November 30. The Suntory Championship was not held, because [[Júbilo Iwata]] was the winner of both stages. At the end of the season, [[Sanfrecce Hiroshima]] and [[Hokkaido Consadole Sapporo|Consadole Sapporo]] were relegated to J2. ==General== ===Promotion and relegation=== * At the end of the [[2001 J.League Division 1|2001 season]], [[Kyoto Sanga FC|Kyoto Purple Sanga]] and [[Vegalta Sendai]] were promoted to J1. * At the end of the [[2001 J.League Division 1|2001 season]], [[Avispa Fukuoka]] and [[Cerezo Osaka]] were relegated to J2. ===Changes in competition formats=== * [[Extra time]] was scratched for [[J2 League|J.League Division 2]]. After regulation time, clubs in J2 now receives 3pts for a win, 1pt for a tie, and 0pts for a loss.
